summary: FasterCapital remains active as a Dubai-based global online incubator/accelerator and venture builder. Official pages list rolling availability, with founders able to apply anywhere and anytime, but no fixed 2026 cohort dates or application deadlines are published.

proposed_event.name: FasterCapital Global Venture Builder Programs
proposed_event.description: Global online incubator/venture builder offering fundraising, tech cofounder, growth, and idea-to-product support for startups.

dates.date_range_text: Rolling online applications; official site says founders can apply anywhere and anytime to FasterCapital programs.

sources.title: Leading the Way in Global Venture Building and Online Incubation - FasterCapital
sources.supports: States FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator based in Dubai; lists main programs including Tech Cofounder, Idea to Product, Grow your Startup, Raise Capital, and Mega Financing; says founders can apply anywhere and anytime; provides Dubai office addresses.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions - FasterCapital
sources.supports: Describes FasterCapital as an online incubator/accelerator based in Dubai, country-agnostic, serving startups across stages from idea through Series A and beyond.

sources.title: Raise Capital for Your Startup - FasterCapital
sources.supports: Describes the Raise Capital program process, investor matching, fit for seed through Series B rounds, and clarifies direct investment is handled through other programs when relevant.

sources.title: Find Your Technical Cofounder, Team, or CTO at FasterCapital
sources.supports: Describes the Tech Cofounder program, technical support network, and claims FasterCapital invests 50% of total costs for that program.

notes: No official fixed 2026 application deadline, cohort start date, program end date, or demo day was found on the reviewed official pages.
Timezone is left null because the reviewed sources identify Dubai as the base/location but do not explicitly state an IANA timezone for applications or programming.
The existing 2025 event appears stale only in the year-specific date_range_text; the program itself is still active with rolling applications.
